Messages.Author: Alfred Behrends
Messages.Body:
I need some clarification on MRC:

Card Text:
Only usable during a referendum before voting occurs. If the referendum
passes, then the next referendum you successfully call passes automatically.

1: Can I use Charming Lobby to call the next referendum and hence
the next referendum will pass automatically too?

2: Can I modify an automatically passed referendum with Cryptic Ryder
and (guess what) the next referendum will pass automatically too?

3: Can someone play Delaying Tactics on a referendum that would
automatically pass? And if yes: Would that cancelled action count
as successfully called?

THX in advance.

Alf Behrends
Braunschweig - Germany
